scope: Five fresh/prepared packaged-app pairs plus five backend runtime samples on one Apple M4 Pro / macOS 27 development host. OS caches were not purged; not a cold-cache, reference-device or release acceptance result.
decision: Prepared workspace readiness and warm compilation remain fast on this development host. Fresh runtime initialization and first-PDF variance remain open. The first backend sample's 43.5-second initialization and fresh first-PDF 46.1-second outlier rule out a reproducible cold-start speed claim or a sub-0.2-second verification claim. V8 diagnostics identify full runtime verification as the largest named main-isolate context, so correctness-preserving verification work is the prioritized investigation; no cache/lazy change is justified without separate design and qualification.
limits: Fresh means a new app profile and managed runtime, not physically cold storage.
First-paint metrics are Chromium navigation metrics, not physical-display timestamps.
No supported minimum macOS/device matrix, cache purge, or native-library validation tracing is included.
